=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text loop "by loop, below 1000: "
text pre "by formula, below 10^"
text col ": "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note the multiples of k below n add up to k * m * (m + 1) / 2 with m = (n - 1) / k; inclusion-exclusion
note removes the multiples of 15 counted twice. Below 10^9 every product stays under 2^64
fn sm k ulong n ulong to ulong
m = div sub n 1 k
ret div mul mul k m add m 1 2
end
fn main to int
s = ulong 0
for i ulong 1000
if or eq rem i 3 0 eq rem i 5 0
s = add s i
end
end
emit loop
emitu s
emit nl
n = ulong 10
for e ulong 9
emit pre
emitu add e 1
emit col
emitu sub add sm 3 n sm 5 n sm 15 n
emit nl
n = mul n 10
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
